title: Git Namespaces — Link Forge Account — payload
description: A member begins linking their account on a forge to their DID. The response carries where the member goes to authorise it; the member then polls git-ns/account/link-status.

forge.description: The forge whose account to link.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Link Forge Account — response payload

linkId.description: Identifies this attempt for git-ns/account/link-status. Opaque; meaningful only to the member who began it.

url.description: Where the member authorises the link: the device-code entry page (GitHub), or the forge's authorisation page (Forgejo, authorisation code with PKCE).

userCode.description: The code the member types at `url`, for a forge that uses a device flow. Absent otherwise.

expiresAt.description: When this attempt lapses if not completed.
